headline: Discussion on National Grid petition for easement inside Forest Dale Cemetery wall and update to Cemetery Handbook.
summary: The board will discuss a petition by National Grid for an easement inside the Forest Dale Cemetery wall, and review an update to the Cemetery Handbook. The meeting also includes correspondence, a trust report, and the superintendent's report.
items: Old Business - Discussion on petition by National Grid for easement inside Forest Dale Cemetery wall
location: Forest Dale Cemetery Office, 150 Forest Street, Malden, Massachusetts

October 13, 2026
A meeting of the Board of Trustees of Cemeteries will be held on 
Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 5:00 P.M. at the Forest Dale 
Cemetery Office, 150 Forest Street, Malden, Massachusetts.
 Please Note: “If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please 
contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 
781-397-7000, Ext 2005”
Meeting Agenda
 Approval of meeting minutes from September 16, 2026 and 
September 25, 2026
 Correspondence
 Trust Report
 Superintendent’s Report
 Old Business – Discussion on petition by National Grid for 
easement inside Forest Dale Cemetery wall
 New Business - Update Cemetery Handbook
 General Cemetery Business
